groundTruth: Labels are derived only from explicit authoritative scope rules or controlled counterfactuals at explicit boundaries. Models never establish labels.
splitPolicy: Official recall families are assigned to exactly one split. Reannouncements, expansions, and cross-authority descriptions of one safety event must remain in one family.
antiTuning: Development may be used for tuning. Holdout and stress are immutable after freeze and may not be used to tune a system that is then represented as unseen on those same splits.
technicalFailurePolicy: Provider, timeout, invalid-output, and exhausted-retry failures are tracked separately and never counted as correct abstentions.
paidRunGate: No Nebius or Nemotron inference is authorized until explicit user approval after the offline baseline and run plan are reviewed.
claimBoundary: This is a controlled internal safety evaluation, not a representative estimate of all real-world recalls.
